Section01explanation:
Hello! I am a front-end developer with 4+ years of experience specializing in React/Next.js product development, CI/CD, E2E test automation, DevOps, and API collaboration.

I have built real-world products including AI-based protein analysis platforms, pathology image analysis platforms, and smart factory monitoring systems. Beyond UI implementation, I focus on deployment stability, test automation, performance optimization, and improving collaboration processes.

I have consistently led DevOps initiatives — CI/CD pipeline design, E2E test automation, security and quality inspection systems. Recently, I introduced Claude Code-based AI development workflows to enhance productivity.
